design_concept: Professional Creative Studio (Terminal/Luxury Hybrid). Optimized for long-session photo editing, minimizing eye strain while making photo colors pop.

rules.headings: Manrope, tight tracking (tracking-tight), font-medium to font-bold. Never use Inter.
rules.body: Manrope, text-sm for standard UI labels.
rules.numbers_and_data: JetBrains Mono. Use for slider values, dimensions (e.g., 50x60mm), and coordinate data. Gives a technical, precise feel.

grids_and_layouts.left_toolbar: w-16 flex-shrink-0 border-r border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900 flex flex-col items-center py-4 gap-4 z-10
grids_and_layouts.center_stage: flex-1 relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center overflow-hidden bg-black
grids_and_layouts.right_panel: w-80 flex-shrink-0 border-l border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900 flex flex-col overflow-y-auto z-10
grids_and_layouts.canvas_area: Workspace must have generous padding (p-12) around the actual photo to allow zooming and panning.
grids_and_layouts.print_sheet_grid: 2x2 grid setup for the print layout with exactly thin gray dashed lines (stroke-dasharray: '4 4').

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' (The Technical Look) for the right panel sections. Divide properties with border-b border-zinc-800.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px borders (#27272A) for separation instead of shadows, keeping the UI flat and professional like Lightroom.
visual_enhancers.canvas_background: Use an SVG checkerboard pattern on the center stage to indicate transparency when background is removed.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in the main workspace to prevent color distortion. Use Solid Backgrounds for all sidebars.

component_usage.sliders: Shadcn Slider. Customize: track should be thin (h-1 bg-zinc-800), thumb should be small and use the accent color (#06B6D4). Value must be displayed next to slider in JetBrains Mono.
component_usage.buttons: Square or rounded-sm. No pill shapes for this technical tool. Primary buttons use bg-cyan-500 text-black hover:bg-cyan-400.
component_usage.toggles: ToggleGroup for tool selection (e.g., Retouch, Garment, Red Eye). Active state must have a crisp cyan border or icon tint.
component_usage.tabs: Use minimal tabs for switching between 'Düzenle' (Edit) and 'Baskı' (Print) modes. Active tab gets a bottom border (border-b-2 border-cyan-500).

motion.interactions: Instantaneous or extremely fast (100ms) transitions. Tool selection should feel snappy, not floaty.
motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out for buttons/icons. NEVER use 'transition-all'.
motion.loaders: Minimalist spinner or progress bar using the accent cyan color.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA standards. Gray text (#A1A1AA) on dark gray (#18181B) is high enough contrast.
accessibility.focus: All sliders and inputs must have focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500 focus:outline-none.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for all left-toolbar icons since they lack text.

media_and_icons.icon_rules: Stroke width 1.5. Size 20px for sidebar, 16px for panel sub-tools.

image_urls.description: Örnek Kadın Vesikalık (Sample image for testing auto-framing and background removal)

domain_specific_rules.watermark: Watermark band (orta banda filigran) must have adjustable opacity and thickness tied to a slider. Overlay in center of print sheet.
domain_specific_rules.cut_lines: Kesim çizgileri (cut lines) must be visible but non-intrusive. Thin dashed #A1A1AA lines bordering the 2x2 grid elements.

universal_guidelines: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts. The workspace MUST follow the precise 3-column structural layout.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on their role (e.g., data-testid='brightness-slider').
Never apply transition: all in CSS.
Do not use complete transparent background on headers or panels with content underneath.
